Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::checkCreditHistory(): CreditHistory {
	definition:
		currentLoanRequest: LoanRequest = CurrentLoanRequest,
		obs: Set(CreditHistory) = CreditHistory.allInstance()->select(o|o.LinkedLoanRequest = currentLoanRequest)
	precondition:
		currentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		obs.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		let creditHistory: CreditHistory in
		creditHistory.oclIsNew() and
		CreditHistory.allInstance()->includes(creditHistory)
}
